AutoModel.from_pretrained(name) downloads the configuration and the weights of a pretrained model and returns a PyTorch module. Call model.save_pretrained(directory) to store both, then load the saved directory later without a network connection.

AutoModelForSequenceClassification adds a classification head on top of the encoder, which is randomly initialized when it is not part of the checkpoint. The head must be trained before its scores are useful.

Fixture note: the token tiebreakmarker appears in exactly two chunks with identical text, so a model-free score cannot separate them and the chunk id decides. The model is irrelevant here.
